state_resolution.ready: all required trust signals pass on the live shipped release surface
state_resolution.degraded: one or more non-blocking trust signals warn while required release drill evidence remains present
state_resolution.blocked: any required trust signal fails or any checked-in source contract drifts

trust_owner.claim_boundary: trust reports are projections of release drill evidence, not independent manual badges

release_drill_owner.claim_boundary: release credibility blocks unless package channel, release operations, and release evidence drill inputs remain attached

trust_signals.claim_boundary: release payload provenance and reproducibility are only credible when tied to the live manifest sbom and attestation outputs
distribution claims are only credible when the installable channel surfaces still produce rollback-safe smoke artifacts
versioning update and rollback guidance must resolve to the live compatibility publication outputs
credibility claims must retain a machine-generated evidence index for the shipped conformance artifacts
